voice.name: Lucas - Deep, Raspy and Natural
voice.why: A deep, raspy French voice for Vince at the fence yard: low and in no hurry. The game has male bodies only; the voice is male.

greet.text: You did not see me. Now, what are you after?

what.text: I sell tools to people who do not ask what they are for. Locks are hard and the police are harder. Choose the right tool.

where.text: Ask nobody about me. Keep to the back streets.

rumour.text: Somebody sold a drill and a charge to the wrong customer. The wrong customer was the police.
